concept.subject: Round paper lanterns on a festival wire against a summer sky with white clouds: a gray one on the left, a red one in the middle and a yellow one on the right, and a string of small lanterns gliding around and around a figure-eight loop knotted at the red one.
concept.composition: One wire crosses the picture at a little under half the height, sagging on the left and rising to the right. A gray lantern hangs at the left edge, a red one just right of the middle and a yellow one near the right edge, each about a seventh of the picture wide. A big white cloud fills the upper left and reaches down through the middle behind the red lantern; blue sky fills the right; low clouds lie along the bottom right.
concept.layout: 93 round pegs and 48 bricks. Sixteen small lanterns (pegs) travel around a figure eight lying on its side, 530 px wide and 300 px high, crossing itself at the red lantern; the left loop is the longer one, so the lanterns pass the crossing apart. The gray and the yellow lantern are rings of curved bricks. Pegs follow the wire inside each loop, the red lantern's hook and bottom opening, the cloud edges inside the loops and over the knot, and the clouds and the sky along the top and the bottom. Brick billows trace the big cloud's underside in the upper left and its right edge beside the cannon, a brick arc its underside below the red lantern, and a shorter one the low cloud at the bottom right.

moving.what: 16 lanterns traveling around the figure eight, phases spread evenly

features: Pegs in an infinity shape that spin in a loop (spec 8): a lantern string

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the gliding lanterns are easy to hit by luck and hard to hit on purpose, and they sweep through the middle of the board, where only the four pegs over the knot stay open near the cannon.

background.prompt: A photo of three round paper lanterns hanging from one thin wire against a summer sky. The wire crosses the picture at a little under half the height, sagging slightly on the left and rising to about a third of the height at the right edge. A gray lantern hangs at the left edge, centered at about a tenth of the width and 0.55 of the height; a red lantern hangs just right of the middle, at about 0.52 of the width and 0.54 of the height; a yellow lantern with red ribs hangs near the right edge, at about 0.9 of the width and 0.48 of the height; each is about a seventh of the picture wide. A big white cloud fills the upper left and reaches down through the middle behind the red lantern to about four fifths of the height; blue sky fills the right half and the lower left; low white clouds lie along the bottom right. The top center is cloud and sky; the lower corners are sky and cloud.

picture.title: Vibrant red, blue, and orange paper lanterns hanging on a wire against a clear blue sky with clouds.
picture.author: Sóc Năng Động
